comments.comment: 17:36 this moment of the video was very intimate. If you look at the natives around him the boy with the green shirt is looking at himself through the viewfinder display on the Camera. I dont know for certain, but it's very possible that was the first time that little boy EVER saw his reflection or an image of himself that wasn't a reflection through the water. You can see how interested they are in looking at themselves with how intrigued they all looked.  I never thought about how much i take for granted in the simple things in just being able to look at myself on a daily basis in a mirror. There's a good chance some of those children don't even fully understand the way they look and the things that make them unique and individuals. Its really interesting to think about a society without reflections, a place where only others knew what you really looked like but you yourself are none the wiser. I feel like the world would be a bit of a better place if we weren't so worried about the way we look, because it really doesn't matter. Makes you wonder if its actually more of a burden to know what one looks likes because then you just worry about it more.
